build_CustomRCNN: build a CustomRCNN model from a Detectron2 config with image labels and caption support
run_CustomRCNN_inference: run inference on batched inputs using CustomRCNN to detect instances with postprocessing
run_CustomRCNN_forward: run the CustomRCNN forward pass with batched inputs to compute detection losses
review_CustomRCNN_from_config: review the CustomRCNN from_config class method to extract config parameters for initialization
review_CustomRCNN_sync_caption_features: review the CustomRCNN _sync_caption_features method that gathers caption features across GPU ranks
